text.fa: برچسب خطر مشخصی برای بارداری ذکر نکرده یا داده کافی ندارد؛ فقط در صورت لزوم و با نظر پزشک.
text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary There are no adequate and well-controlled studies of SYMBICORT or one of its individual components, formoterol fumarate, in pregnant women; however studies are available for the other component budesonide.

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary There are no available data on the effects of SYMBICORT, budesonide or formoterol fumarate on the breastfed child or on milk production.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: Safety and effectiveness of SYMBICORT in asthma patients 12 years of age and older have been established in studies up to 12 months.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: As with other products containing beta 2 -agonists, special caution should be observed when using SYMBICORT in geriatric patients who have concomitant cardiovascular disease that could be adversely affected by beta 2 -agonists.
